name: hypermove.xyz
description: The HyperMove MCP Gateway v3.0 — one Model Context Protocol endpoint for external-protocol integration: cross-chain web3 data (EVM + Stellar + XRPL + Flare + GOAT), FTSO oracle, builder briefs, daily news + AI insight, agentic tools, and per-query x402/MPP payment settled via n-payment. Agent-skills install & run locally in your workspace (GET /api/skills) — MCP is not required to install or run a skill.

transport.note: Connect with any MCP client. POST/GET /api/mcp with Accept: application/json, text/event-stream.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ranked hybrid search over the unified cross-chain catalog.

tools.name: data.call
tools.description: Execute live cross-chain reads (EVM + Stellar Horizon/Soroban + XRPL + Flare FTSO + GOAT).

tools.name: codemode.news.insight
tools.description: AI-synthesized project insight from today's news.

tools.name: insight.roadmap
tools.description: Synthesize a product-upgrade roadmap from news + capabilities.

tools.name: skillify
tools.description: Codify a task into a reusable skill spec.

tools.name: flare.builder.brief
tools.description: Flare builder brief: FTSO + FAssets + FDC + FCC capabilities + corpus + news. Opt-in (FEATURE_MCP_BUILDER_BRIEF).

tools.name: xrpl.builder.brief
tools.description: XRPL builder brief: MPT + vault + lending + amendments + corpus + news. Opt-in (FEATURE_MCP_XRPL_V3).

tools.name: goat.builder.brief
tools.description: GOAT builder brief: BTC-native settlement + lending + MPP + corpus + news. Opt-in (FEATURE_MCP_BUILDER_BRIEF).

tools.name: payments.settle
tools.description: Settle a payment via n-payment (x402/MPP) to unlock a paid session. 5 free calls / 24h, then per-call across four rails.

resources.name: FTSO Price Feed

resources.name: FXRP Bridge Capacity
resources.description: FAssets XRP bridge capacity. Opt-in (FEATURE_MCP_RESOURCES + FEATURE_MCP_FLARE).
